source_spans.locator: Psychological Review 111(4), PDF p.1 / published p.1036, abstract: specialized modules expose limited buffer contents to a central selector that chooses one rule at a time
Psychological Review 111(4), PDF p.2 / published p.1037, architecture overview: visual/manual/retrieval/goal modules communicate with the central system through buffers
Psychological Review 111(4), PDF p.3 / published p.1038, critical cycle: module-determined buffers -> pattern recognition -> one selected rule -> buffer updates
Psychological Review 111(4), PDF p.9 / published p.1044, control section: multiple applicable rules compete, serial execution selects one according to utility

conditions: integrated task performance requiring coordination among specialized perceptual, action, goal and retrieval subsystems
substrate: multiple specialized cortical-associated subsystems and a central selection loop
task: coordinate perception, goal maintenance, retrieval and action through a shared control cycle
temporal_scope: repeating serial selection cycles interleaved with parallel subsystem processing

nodes.description: set of specialized perceptual, action, goal and retrieval subsystems with partly encapsulated internal processing
small interface states through which each specialized subsystem exposes selected information to the central selector
joint pattern of currently exposed interface states available to central control
multiple condition-action mappings that may match the current interface-state pattern
scalar control quantity used to choose among simultaneously applicable mappings
single condition-action mapping chosen for serial execution on the current cycle
change or subsystem request produced by execution of the selected mapping
repeating sequence from exposed interface states through rule selection to updated interface states

relations.description: each specialized subsystem makes only a limited portion of its internal processing available through its interface state
which condition-action mappings are applicable depends on the current joint pattern of exposed interface states
serial control selects one applicable mapping according to its control value
executing the selected mapping changes interface states or issues requests to specialized subsystems
each control cycle orders current interface exposure before selection and selection before the next interface update
central coordination is constrained to the limited information exposed by subsystem interfaces rather than unrestricted access to all subsystem-internal activity
